statement: OperationWorkflowOwner serializes two message-group REPLACE operations that mint permanently fresh replica and raft peer identities, commit each target as a learner, admit exactly one physical target through the existing durable CREATE fence, install or replay real group state, atomically prove catch-up and propose promotion in the raft runtime owner, confirm the voter, hand leadership off, commit and observe source removal, and perform exact-generation cleanup. Ordinary terminal settlement, durable membership obligations, physical cleanup and storage reservations retain their distinct existing owners. After two serial replacements mg-1 has two voters on distinct off-seed storage and continues authoritative SQL routing, CDC and cache hydration after seed loss, while direct or stale membership traffic, cache-owned admission, identity reuse, overlapping replacement, early cleanup and legacy consensus remain refused.

constraints.statement: RebalanceCoordinator and ReplicaOperationRepository own authoritative operation admission and monotonic membership phase; OperationWorkflowOwner is the sole runtime driver; raft-rs group membership admission and the runtime port are the sole configuration/progress owners; identity81 owns CREATE linearization; lifecycle owners own rows and cleanup. No second workflow, progress ledger, local consumer fix or RawNode boundary is introduced.

Ordinary terminal settlement never waits for or grants membership removal or artifact deletion. An unresolved exact membership obligation retains the per-group lane until fresh committed absence; an exact terminal cleanup claim may retain the already-terminal row without holding the lane. Approved 44592 storage reservation retain, release, expiry, recovery and physical accounting remain unchanged and exact-generation authoritative.

Every target has a fresh deterministic logical identity and derived raft peer id. Committed configuration context installs the exact identity mapping on surviving replicas and snapshots; it is not pruned with operation history. Address is routing metadata and may be reused only with the distinct committed identity.

A current leader commits ADD_LEARNER and produces a read-only exact join descriptor before physical CREATE. The existing durable CREATE CAS then permits one worker to create files, install a validated real snapshot or replay real log, and open as a learner. Terminal-first and forged requests perform zero physical work; no genesis/voter shortcut is permitted.

A single raft runtime-owner turn compares a fresh target-owned applied ConfState generation with the leader's current generation, validates both as known canonical non-negative integer configuration generations, and validates real leader-owned commit and follower-match indexes before calling the existing promotion predicate; missing values cannot normalize to a synthetic 0/0 grant. The turn proposes ADD_PEER before leaving. Replicated identity context must survive the semantic port's normalized conf-change path into actual ready/apply and committed mapping, rather than existing only on the request. A later fresh committed voter observation alone advances lifecycle/workflow.

The source remains ACTIVE through target voter proof and named leadership handoff. Current leader/quorum fresh committed absence resolves membership serialization and authorizes the exact cleanup claim; the source's own applied absence separately permits stopping its port. BACKSTOP only redrives or diagnoses and cannot stop or delete.

Operation creation binds an authoritative source SERVICES incarnation. Operation-owned lifecycle transitions use exact CAS, a stable cleanup token and advancing state_entered_at. Restart may adopt only allowed forward states with the same created_at, create attempt and cleanup token. Successor generations, stale source disks and unavailable authority remain protected.

The message-group checkpoint/log path owns the exact raft ConfState and applied boundary plus peer map, and scrubs sender-local lifecycle/runtime facts. It does not make operationLedger, MESSAGE/ACK or cache durable. Canonical SQL stays partition-owned; routing, CDC and cache hydration after seed loss are cross-owner recovery proof, not copied message-group state.

R1 fully resolves membership before R2 enters the authoritative lane. B4 and C5 use distinct non-seed nodes and storage roots; after restart and seed storage loss they form quorum 2/3, elect, commit and read a new authoritative SQL mutation, deliver CDC and rebuild routing/cache state. There is no five-voter shortcut.

Direct CREATE, ADD, MOVE, identity-keeping replacement, concurrent replacement, cache-owned admission/promotion, wrong identity/role/address binding, stale proof, cleanup before absence, retired_group forgery and legacy consensus remain refused. Founder bootstrap and valid durable own rejoin retain their narrow authority. R7, late leader row, co-located follower, deleted MOVE handoff, unsupported upgrade, cloud, release and generic R8 work are excluded.

The implementation is scoped to the existing planner/rebalancer operation admission and identity paths, ReplicaOperationRepository and OperationWorkflowOwner membership/REPLACE helpers, MessageGroupServiceHandler setup and CREATE/removal ingress, ReplicaCreateAdmissionOwner and lifecycle row owners, message-group consensus/lifecycle/checkpoint routes, raft-rs-group-membership-admission, learner-promotion-progress, and their owner-interaction metadata. Likely paths are the exact V1 census: src/rebalancer/unified-rebalancer-rebalance-loop.js, rebalance-coordinator-operation-creation*.js, rebalance-coordinator-replica-identity-methods.js, rebalance-replace-intent-identity.js, replica-operation-repository*.js, replica-operation-step-policy.js, operation-workflow-owner*.js, operation-workflow-replace-*.js, unified-rebalancer-replica-state.js, replica-operation-constants.js; src/node/message-group-service-handler*.js, message-group-create-activation.js, replica-create-admission-owner.js, replica-removal-consensus-exit.js; src/bootstrap/shared/message-group-service-handler-setup.js and composition roots; src/message-group/message-group-consensus-port.js, message-group-service-raft-lifecycle.js, message-group-service-row-owner.js and group-neutral checkpoint/log/snapshot routes; src/raft/raft-rs-group-membership-admission.js and learner-promotion-progress.js. Any new helper remains subordinate to one of these owners, and scope changes require a new recorded judgment and review.

The sealed proof plan includes test/rebalancer/message-group-membership-operation-lane.test.js, message-group-fresh-identity-two-replace.test.js, and the existing message-group-membership-change-parked.test.js; test/node/message-group-service-handler-membership.test.js, message-group-create-admission-recovery.test.js, the existing message-group-service-handler.test.js, and replica-removal-consensus-exit.test.js; test/message-group/message-group-fresh-learner-promotion.test.js, message-group-replace-removal-fence.test.js, and message-group-fresh-learner-snapshot.test.js; raft peer-identity/bootstrap controls; and test/integration/message-group-fresh-identity-replacement.integration.test.js. Cells cover direct and terminal-first CREATE, same-boot/lost-answer/boot-takeover admission, wrong or reused identity/address/role, ADD_LEARNER and REMOVE answer loss, unavailable/non-numeric configuration generation or leader progress, replicated conf-change context through actual ready/apply, stale proof after term/config drift, concurrent R2, target failure before and after materialization, named handoff, leader/quorum versus source-own absence, BACKSTOP refusal, cleanup before absence, successor generation, pruning, stale source disk, cache-forged voter role, and unrelated deferred-row isolation.

On the exact clean combined base, archive controls showing planner typed park, direct CREATE refusal, zero production ADD_LEARNER caller, a positive operation-authorized REPLACE red at the planner/admission boundary, an authorized committed-learner CREATE red, and a real distinct-off-seed seed-loss red before B4 exists. The initial eight receipts remain fail. Closure requires every named focused command, impact-contract and applicable registry/metadata/guideline/closure audits, diff-check, one uninterrupted test:static, and exact-byte locked ordinary/bootstrap/exclusive changed lanes against the same combined base. The exclusive lane must select the physical two-replacement seed-storage-loss SQL/CDC/cache witness; focused component green cannot substitute.
Every source attempt requires independent verification newer than the attempt and recorded with verifier subagent:<id> before landing.
